02Debugging

A bug I tracked down

Google sign-in on Femabrás, and why it only broke for some people.

  1. Step 1

    Symptom

    Google sign-in worked for some visitors and failed for others, within the same hour.

  2. Step 2

    Clue

    It only failed when /login was the first page loaded, never when you clicked through.

  3. Step 3

    Cause

    Server rendering wrote our internal Docker address into the link. Browsers can't reach it.

  4. Step 4

    Fix

    Links the browser follows now use a separate public URL.

Lesson: test the first load of a page, not only the path you click through.

03Process

How I work

  1. Decide first

    Every big choice gets a written decision record. More than 50 so far.

  2. One gate

    Lint, types, tests, a vulnerability scan and a production build before every commit.

  3. Fix the cause

    I name the real cause. No patch that hides a defect.

  4. AI-assisted

    Claude Code writes, I review every diff. Docs ship with the change.
